independentSpotCheck.method: Re-navigated live to each sampled product's own detail page (a different view path than the category-listing pass used for card-level data) and re-extracted reference (sku), price, case material, and dial color directly from the DOM in a fresh page load, comparing against the values already written to the market/history files.
independentSpotCheck.coverage: one representative per each of the four families (Seamaster, Speedmaster, Constellation, De Ville), two same-base-reference-prefix configuration pairs (De Ville Prestige 434.20.42.22.0x/1x, Speedmaster '38 324.30.38.50.0x), lowest price, highest price, second-highest price, three isNewModel=true items, four officially-named special/anomaly editions (Chrono Chime, Ultra Deep Planet Ocean 6000M, James Bond 60th Anniversary Diver 300M, Summer Blue Ploprof), the rare 2-item Tourbillon category, and two of the 34 dial-field-absent references.
independentSpotCheck.results: 20/20 exact matches, 0 diffs, including both null-dial items independently reconfirmed as genuinely absent (not a scraping artifact) on live reload.

limitations: 34/554 references have dialDescription: null (official page lacks a structured dial-color field), documented in collection-summary.json; not guessed.
priceType/taxRatePercent determined from a Korean NTS written ruling establishing a legal deemed-inclusive default, not an explicit Omega statement — documented in collection-summary.json.
jsonSchemaValidation NOT RUN due to missing validator; manual equivalent checks substituted (see above).
